$comment: FlightResist AI 2.0 — MCP tool surface for Qoder workspace import. The runtime is REAL: src/app/api/mcp/route.ts serves MCP-over-HTTP (JSON-RPC 2.0: initialize, tools/list, tools/call) and each tool delegates to the same deterministic engine the REST routes use. Point `url` at the running server (default http://localhost:3000/api/mcp). No capability is claimed that the app does not actually perform.

tools.name: get_current_trip
tools.description: Returns the active trip session: itinerary, state machine state, risk score, provider mode, ledger.

tools.name: trigger_disruption
tools.description: Simulates an inbound disruption webhook for a flight on the active itinerary and starts the autonomous recovery analysis pipeline.

tools.name: get_recovery_options
tools.description: Returns the deterministic analysis: 42-candidate funnel, pruned summary, 3 ranked options with multi-criteria scores, and the LLM explanation.

tools.name: confirm_recovery
tools.description: The human approval gate: executes the approved proposal through the active provider (DemoProvider simulated, or AtlasSandboxProvider when the atlas-flight CLI is present).

tools.name: reset_session
tools.description: Resets the demo session to NORMAL (execution ledger is preserved).
